nodes.title: Positive
widgets_values:
A slender Asian woman is taking a full-length mirror selfie outdoors next to a warm brown brick wall. 

[0-2.0s]: The woman stands perfectly still in a front-facing mirror selfie pose, showcasing her cream-white blouse and mini skirt. Soft afternoon golden hour sunlight creates gentle shadows. Gentle breeze rustles her long hair and skirt hem. Camera remains static.
[2.0-4.5s]: She smoothly turns her body 45 degrees to her right side, displaying her side profile and the details of her outfit. Her yellow straw handbag sways naturally with her movement. The camera executes a very subtle pan right to create a slight parallax depth.
[4.5-6.0s]: Keeping the side pose, she gently and playfully swings her small yellow woven handbag forward and backward. The texture of the straw bag catches the warm sunlight.
[6.0-7.0s]: She smoothly turns back to the initial front-facing mirror selfie pose, settling into a stable frame as the video ends.

Cinematic lighting, high-fidelity textile texture, photorealistic, natural and continuous human motion, perfect hand and phone geometry, no distortion, no morphing.
